ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Advanced Digital Interaction. This advanced studio immerses students in design investigations that stimulate awareness of emergent digital interaction paradigms. Potential areas of exploration include design and development for both mobile devices and interactive environments. Basic proficiency and comfort with HTML, CSS, and a scripting or programming language, as well as access to a laptop computer for every class session, is required. Prerequisite: ARTD 313 or consent of instructor. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term. Undergraduate Section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or New Media major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
